bot_blocking: app.enhancedvoting.com: plain relay User-Agent got 200 on everything; no challenge. The state's OLD site results.arizona.vote is different: it is behind a Cloudflare managed challenge ('Just a moment…'). Windows system curl 8.22 with the relay UA got 403 + challenge page; headless Chrome never got past the challenge (60 s timeout); Git Bash curl 8.8 with the same relay UA got 200 on the home page, default.html and four of five script files (one 403). That site is not needed for 2026-11-03.
updated_field: election.asOf, e.g. '2026-11-10T23:00:55.866264Z' (UTC). Also election.lastUpdated '2026-11-10T04:02:19.9733708Z', election.publishDate '2026-11-10T23:00:56.3424059Z', and reportingStatus.asOf per contest.
reporting_field: Per contest: ballotItems[].reportingStatus.reportingUnits / totalUnits, counted in COUNTIES (Governor: 15 / 15; US House District 2: 9 / 9). Per county: jurisdiction.childLocalities[].percentReporting (0.8333333 for the first county) and precinctsReporting (1.0), both fractions. election.precinctsReporting is null.

choice_format: Party is inside the name text and also a separate object: 'Katie Hobbs (DEM) / John Giles (PND)' with party.abbreviation 'DEM' (governor is a ticket; each half carries its own party in parentheses). Write-in lines appear as options: 'Unofficial Write-in', 'Unassigned Write-in', and named write-ins with a trailing space ('Alice Novoa '). Measures have contestType 'BallotMeasure' with options 'YES' and 'NO' (order varies: options are not always YES first). Judicial retention is also BallotMeasure, options 'Be retained YES' / 'Be retained NO'.
district_field: Only in the title, as 'District No. N'; state legislative titles pad single digits with an extra space ('State Senator - District No.  1' has two spaces, 'District No. 10' one). No separate district field. State Representative is vote-for-2.
